description:
[Updates] One Facepunch devblog: what it added - new skins, their value, drops, player peak. The data behind https://rust.wiki/updates/<slug> (devblogs only): Facepunch's `summary` and link, the RustProfit
blog explainer when there is one, every skin released in the update's `window` (until the next devblog) with
its price (USD cents, Steam lowest listing; first 60 listed, `skin_count` for all), how many were store skins vs
Twitch/Kick drops, their total value now, the drop collections, that month's Steam player peak and the previous /
next devblog. Devblog slugs come from get_rust_updates.
name: get_update
title: One Facepunch devblog: what it added - new skins, their value, drops, player peak
